issues.description: A lithium cell is enclosed in the product: it needs a retention feature, clearance from heat sources and pinch-free assembly.
issues.fix: Add a cell cradle with retention ribs and ≥2 mm clearance from the driver/charger area, keep the protection circuit on the cell path, and use a UL94 V-0 enclosure material.
issues.rule_citation: IEC 62133-2 (secondary lithium cells) cell protection and thermal abuse clauses; UL 94 V-0 for battery enclosures

issues.description: The outdoor enclosure specifies weather seals but no seal profile, compression stop, or sealing method at the solar-panel and cable interfaces. A factory cannot validate repeatable water resistance.
issues.fix: Specify an enclosure ingress-protection target, gasket cross-section and compression, gland sizes, panel seal detail, and a production leak test.
issues.rule_citation: Define and verify enclosure ingress protection — IEC 60529.

issues.description: The solar-powered design lists no energy storage or power budget for operating the controller and solenoid valve without sunlight.
issues.fix: Define valve voltage, current, and duty cycle; calculate worst-case energy demand; add appropriately rated storage and charging circuitry if nighttime operation is required.
issues.rule_citation: Verify supply capability against load current and duty cycle — standard power-budget design practice.

issues.description: The self-tapping screws and boss pilots are specified, but boss outer diameter, engagement depth, and screw installation torque are not. The factory cannot confirm stripping resistance or shell clamp load.
issues.fix: Dimension the complete bosses and screw engagement, then validate pilot size and torque with molded-part assembly trials.
issues.rule_citation: Size plastic screw bosses and validate installation torque to prevent cracking and stripping — Protolabs injection molding design guide.

issues.description: Minimum wall draft is 1.46°: enough for a polished finish, short of the ~3° a textured finish ('Matte texture · Warm white #EDEBE6') needs.
issues.fix: Increase draft to 3° on textured faces, or specify a lighter texture / polished finish.
issues.rule_citation: Draft ≥1° plus 1° per 0.025 mm texture depth — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; measured with text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Min wall draft vs pull +Z: lowest-draft B-rep wall face ≥ 173.84 mm² (curved, 277.52 mm² at [-64.98, 19.98, 11.69]) — text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

issues.description: Projected area along +Z: 8805 mm² (part silhouette, per cavity). Estimated clamp force ≈ 45.0 t (Estimate: area in² × 3.0 t/in² for PC/ABS × 1.1 safety) — per cavity; a family tool moulding both shells in one shot roughly doubles it.
issues.fix: Quote on a press ≥ 60 t; keep both shells in one family mould only if tonnage allows.
issues.rule_citation: Clamp force ≈ projected area × cavity-pressure factor (2-5 t/in²) — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; silhouette raster from text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Silhouette along +Z, raster 0.375 mm — text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

issues.description: Measured wall 2.00-2.00 mm is within the PC/ABS 1.2-3.5 mm range; keep bosses/ribs ≤ 60% of nominal wall to avoid sink.
issues.fix: No change to nominal wall; core bosses and ribs to ≤ 60% of the wall.
issues.rule_citation: PC/ABS wall 1.2-3.5 mm, ribs/bosses ≤ 60% of wall — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: 5th percentile of 11860 ray samples into the material (median 2.0 mm)

issues.description: Tight shell mating-face tolerances and the split-line step limit lack a defined datum scheme or assembled tolerance stack. Parts may pass separate inspections yet assemble with a visible offset.
issues.fix: Define shell datums and alignment features; tolerance the locating features and verify the assembled stack at the split line.
issues.rule_citation: Use functional datums and tolerance stack-ups for mating parts — ASME Y14.5.

issues.description: Minimum wall draft is 1.46°: enough for a polished finish, short of the ~3° a textured finish ('Matte texture · Warm white #EDEBE6') needs.
issues.fix: Increase draft to 3° on textured faces, or specify a lighter texture / polished finish.
issues.rule_citation: Draft ≥1° plus 1° per 0.025 mm texture depth — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; measured with text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Min wall draft vs pull +Z: lowest-draft B-rep wall face ≥ 173.84 mm² (curved, 277.52 mm² at [-64.98, 19.98, 11.69]) — text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

issues.description: Projected area along +Z: 8805 mm² (part silhouette, per cavity). Estimated clamp force ≈ 45.0 t (Estimate: area in² × 3.0 t/in² for PC/ABS × 1.1 safety) — per cavity; a family tool moulding both shells in one shot roughly doubles it.
issues.fix: Quote on a press ≥ 60 t; keep both shells in one family mould only if tonnage allows.
issues.rule_citation: Clamp force ≈ projected area × cavity-pressure factor (2-5 t/in²) — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; silhouette raster from text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Silhouette along +Z, raster 0.375 mm — text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

issues.description: Measured wall 2.00-2.00 mm is within the PC/ABS 1.2-3.5 mm range; keep bosses/ribs ≤ 60% of nominal wall to avoid sink.
issues.fix: No change to nominal wall; core bosses and ribs to ≤ 60% of the wall.
issues.rule_citation: PC/ABS wall 1.2-3.5 mm, ribs/bosses ≤ 60% of wall — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: 5th percentile of 11860 ray samples into the material (median 2.0 mm)

issues.description: The weather seals are listed, but the shell joint has no gasket groove, compression specification, or sealing test requirement. Outdoor water ingress cannot be controlled at assembly.
issues.fix: Define the gasket material and cross-section, groove geometry, compression stops, and an enclosure ingress test.
issues.rule_citation: Specify and verify enclosure protection against water ingress — IEC 60529.

issues.description: The rechargeable battery and charge controller have no specified chemistry, capacity, protection functions, or operating temperature range. The factory cannot qualify the charging design.
issues.fix: Specify the cell and matched charge controller, protection requirements, temperature limits, and battery qualification tests.
issues.rule_citation: Safety requirements and tests for portable rechargeable lithium cells and batteries, if lithium chemistry is selected — IEC 62133-2.

issues.description: The battery has no defined retention or routing relative to the shell joint, leaving movement and wire pinching uncontrolled.
issues.fix: Add a retained battery compartment and defined wire channels clear of screw bosses and sealing surfaces.
issues.rule_citation: Prevent battery movement and damage during normal use — IEC 62133-2, if lithium chemistry is selected.

issues.description: The solenoid valve's coil voltage and current are unspecified, so the solar, battery, regulator, switch, and flyback components cannot be verified as a compatible assembly.
issues.fix: Specify the valve coil rating and operating duty cycle; validate startup current, power budget, switching device, and flyback protection.
issues.rule_citation: Component ratings must suit their intended operating conditions — IEC 62368-1.

issues.description: A tight tolerance is applied to all shell mating faces without identifying functional datums or accounting for gasket compression and assembly stack-up.
issues.fix: Define functional datums and tolerances only on locating and sealing features; perform a closure and gasket-compression stack-up.
issues.rule_citation: Dimension functional features from defined datums and verify tolerance stacks — ASME Y14.5.

issues.description: The self-tapping screws and specified boss pilot lack an approved fastener specification, engagement depth, and assembly torque. Strip-out or cracking may vary between production runs.
issues.fix: Select a screw intended for plastics and validate pilot size, boss depth, insertion torque, and strip torque in molded samples.
issues.rule_citation: Validate pilot holes and boss design for thread-forming screws in plastics — SPIROL design guidelines for screws in plastic.
